summary: This sermon explores the 'desert season' of spiritual formation—times when life is difficult but God is intensely present. Using Jesus' 40 days in the wilderness as the primary example, the preacher shows how desert experiences strip away false identities and reveal who we truly are in Christ, preparing us for the mission God has called us to fulfill.
key_points: Desert times are formative gifts, not punishments to endure
Jesus solidified his identity through temptation in the wilderness before beginning ministry
Old Testament figures (Moses, Joseph, David, Israel) all experienced desert formation before fulfilling their calling
The three temptations challenged Jesus to question his identity, authority, and divinity
Desert seasons strip false identities so our true identity in Christ can emerge
big_idea: Desert seasons are invaluable gifts where God strips away our false identities and reveals our true identity in Christ, forming us into his image and preparing us for the mission he has called us to fulfill.
title: SEASONS OF FORMATION: Life is NOT GOOD, God is PRESENT
